title: Record leads and purchases only after durable saves with browser attribution

source.ref: Owner analytics dashboard and user-flow request, 2026-11-13.

detail: Verified lead capture follows durable IDs across signup capture doors; shared idempotency avoids duplicate counts. Checkout carries consenting browser client/session identity into confirmed purchase facts. No migration or mail send. New focused regressions failed before implementation; existing probes were preserved. Implementation proof does not assert production activation.
